newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico shrs reverse initial gains on Wall St slide.
newsitem.headline: Mexico shrs reverse initial gains on Wall St slide.

text.p: Mexican stocks opened moderately higher on Tuesday on buying momentum from the prior session, but succumbed in the early minutes to a slide on the New York Stock Exchange, dealers said.

"Dealing is light. Stocks opened either flat or slightly up on orders carried over from yesterday, but the bustle died down on floor when they saw ADRs were all down in New York," a floor trader said.
The leading IPC share index slipped 1.16 points in the opening minutes of trade, or 0.03 percent, at 4,258.68.
